QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] Stop Cygnus!
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bChief Alex#k in the #bHenesys Ruins#k.
QuestInfo.1:
The moment we've dreamed about for so long has come at last. The moment we finally defeat the corrupt Cygnus. 

#e#rCompleted upon defeating Cygnus (Story)#k
QuestInfo.2: You defeated Cygnus. It will be some time until Henesys returns to how it once was, but we now have hope.

0.0: The moment we've dreamed about for so long, but have been too weak to achieve, has come at last. The moment we finally defeat the corrupt Cygnus.

yes.0: Defeat the Empress and return safely.

no.0: We need your help. Please reconsider.

0.1: #bAnne and Jay#k have been training to defeat Cygnus. I know they are weak compared to you, but please let them join you. This means the world to them.
0.2: Then it's all up to you. Please end this! Defeat the #rcorrupted Empress Cygnus#k!

1.0: Anne and Jay told me everything, but I still can't believe it! The corrupt Empress is finally gone!

yes.0: Hmm. You don't look so good. I know it's difficult. She used to be so dedicated to Maple World...
yes.2: Enough of that though, not all of the knights have come to their senses and the mutant monsters remain. Henesys's road to recovery is long. We may never truly return to the way we were...
yes.3: But because of you, we have hope for the first time. Thank you, I mean it.

mob.0: You haven't defeated Cygnus yet. Pass through the garden and defeat the #rcorrupted Empress#k!
